image_description: A close-up portrait of a rooster (cock) featuring a prominent, bright red serrated comb and wattles. The plumage displays vivid orange hackle feathers on the neck transitioning to darker tones, with a glimpse of black tail feathers in the background. The beak is short, curved, and yellowish-grey. The eye is dark with a reddish iris ring. The image focuses heavily on the head and upper neck region.
